name: Saddle Finance
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the REKT article excerpt.
rootCause: $11M was stolen from Saddle Finance yesterday, with a further $3.8M taken in a rescue by BlockSec. Despite claiming that “user funds are safe”, Saddle later clarified they were only referring to the amount that was not stolen. rekt.news can clarify that the $11 million that was stolen, is not safe.
